name: move_camera
description: Move an empty-hand camera using relative optical metres/radians or one target selector, with the same mode rules as plan_camera_view. Existing planner and master/VAMP full-path checks run before movement. NO_REACHABLE_CHANGE is a calculation outcome with no movement. Never use while holding. Durable request_id: identical retry returns the receipt, never reexecutes. Final completion or explicit UNKNOWN; inspect get_task_status after timeout/disconnection. Local stop/watchdog remains independent. Guarded control enabled; master physical permission still required.

request_id.description: Unique ID for a NEW task. Retry identical inputs with this same ID to find the same task; never replay unknown work with a new ID.

mode.description: relative: supply frame and both vectors, no target selectors. target: supply exactly one target_name or target_cell_id, no relative fields.

translation_m.description: Required in relative mode only: camera-optical [right,down,forward] metres; vector norm <=0.20m. Use [0,0,0] for rotation only.

rotation_rad.description: Required in relative mode only: [roll,pitch,yaw] radians, each within +/-pi. Use [0,0,0] for translation only.

frame.description: Required in relative mode: camera_optical. Forbidden in target mode.

target_name.description: Target mode only: exact remembered target name. Supply this OR target_cell_id, never both.

target_cell_id.description: Target mode only: existing spatial cell ID. Supply this OR target_name, never both.

camera_distance_m.description: Optional target-view distance in metres; used only in target mode.

name: control_gripper
description: Open/close/release through master safeguards. Prepared operations require the exact reviewed plan reference and next valid stage. Close confirms fresh contact; release requires validated placement. Empty-hand open requires fresh feedback and cannot narrow the jaws. No free closing or held release. Opening feedback proves open detection, not calibrated target aperture. Durable request_id: identical retry returns the receipt, never reexecutes. Final completion or explicit UNKNOWN; inspect get_task_status after timeout/disconnection. Local stop/watchdog remains independent. Guarded control enabled; master physical permission still required.

mode.description: prepared requires plan_id/revision; frozen widths/forces only. empty_hand supports open only, requiring width_m and force_n.

plan_id.description: Exact plan_id from the reviewed preparation result.

revision.description: Exact revision paired with that reviewed plan_id.

name: execute_manipulation
description: Execute the exact reviewed grasp_lift or pick_place plan. No latest-plan guessing. Server follows master waiting stages, verifies contact before held motion and commits slots after confirmed release. grasp_lift stops holding the object and keeps ownership. No physical retries or alternatives. Durable request_id: identical retry returns the receipt, never reexecutes. Final completion or explicit UNKNOWN; inspect get_task_status after timeout/disconnection. Local stop/watchdog remains independent. Guarded control enabled; master physical permission still required.

plan_id.description: Exact plan_id from the reviewed preparation result.

revision.description: Exact revision paired with that reviewed plan_id.

stage.description: all executes the remaining supported prepared stages in order. next executes one stage, including gripper/slot bookkeeping boundaries.
